uncensused_surfaces.reason: Counts ORT Compile() entries. No census mechanism reads it, so 'the EP was asked to compile and did not' is not a state the census can report.
Counts Compute() entries. The census infers execution from dispatches_executed instead; a Compute() that entered and dispatched nothing is invisible to it.
Counts subgraphs taken as stubs. A stub subgraph is the identity outcome for the partitioner and no census mechanism observes the count.
Selects a barrier backend probe. Unobserved by the census.
Raises claim logging to Debug. Unobserved by the census.
Writes the per-claim log. Unobserved by the census.
Switches allocations to device-local memory — changes what the EP does on every upload, and no census mechanism observes whether it was in force.
Dumps output bytes. Unobserved by the census.

Selects the packed GEMV path. Investigated 2026-08-02: the switch is resolved in rust/src/ops/quant.rs:345 and enters the program as SPECIALIZATION CONSTANT index 5 of q_gemv.comp, and rust/src/vk/pipeline.rs keys the pipeline cache on (shader_stem, spec_constants) — so the two settings really are two different pipelines. But NO artifact this project produces records a pipeline key or a spec constant: trace.rs's Phase set has PipelineLookup and no payload, and no counter names the variant. So a host-side record of the env var would not close this: R10 asks for an artifact the mechanism PRODUCED whose content varies with its input, and reading env::var from a harness proves nothing about what the EP did with it. UNTIL an EP-side change records the resolved value (or the pipeline key) in an artifact, every kernel observation we hold is silent about which kernel it observed. Owed by Mouse (ops/) with Switch (vk/pipeline.rs): emit the spec-constant vector, or the resolved gemv_packed bool, into the trace or the counters.
Quarantines freed spans. Unobserved by the census.
Sizes the VA reservation. Unobserved by the census.
Raises logging to Info. Unobserved by the census.
